notes: The three *nor*s answer to the three waws, the single `אֵין` carrying the negation over the whole list; no *nor* is `added` (rules 14, 25).

`אֲשֶׁר … שָׁמָּה` with its directive he is retained as one three-morpheme unit under rule 22: the single *whither* carries the relation, the resumption and the direction, so no morpheme is left `unrepresented` (rules 22, 30, 32), headed on the relative.
The ASV margin (*Or, attaineth to do...*) was read and set aside (rule 38).
